## 1. Executive Summary
Huzaifa Malik (known professionally as exhuzaifa and Muhammad Huzaifa Tabassum) is a Senior AI Software Engineer with over 3 years of hands-on production experience architecting autonomous multi-agent systems, enterprise retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and full-stack software applications. He bridges the gap between state-of-the-art machine learning models and enterprise operational software, deploying scalable, fault-tolerant solutions across real estate, financial technology, and web platforms.

In addition to AI engineering, Huzaifa is an accomplished security researcher recognized by the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) Vulnerability Disclosure Program (VDP) for responsibly discovering and disclosing a Critical/Severe (P1) security vulnerability.

---

## 2. NASA Vulnerability Disclosure Program (P1 Severe Achievement)
- Awarding Agency: National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA)
- Formal Acknowledgement Date: October 5, 2026
- Commendation Signatory: Kelvin Taylor, Senior Agency Information Security Officer (SAISO), NASA Office of Chief Information Officer (OCIO)
- Target Asset: `urs.earthdata.nasa.gov` (Earthdata Login)
- Severity Level: Critical / Severe (P1)
- VRT Category: Sensitive Data Exposure > Disclosure of Secrets > PII Leakage / Credential Exposure
- Vulnerability Summary:
  During a collaborative security audit of NASA public-facing assets, Huzaifa Malik and research partners identified a publicly accessible log file on `urs.earthdata.nasa.gov` exposing plaintext user credentials (usernames and passwords). Huzaifa responsibly reported the issue adhering strictly to NASA VDP guidelines without accessing user accounts, thereby safeguarding scientific researchers and NASA cloud infrastructure from unauthorized access.

Excerpt from NASA Letter of Recognition:
"On behalf of the National Aeronautics and Space Administration and NASA’s Vulnerability Disclosure Policy (VDP), we would like to recognize your efforts as an independent security researcher, both in identifying the vulnerability you submitted and for following NASA’s VDP policy and guidelines in responsibly reporting this to us... Your reporting has facilitated NASA’s awareness of otherwise unknown vulnerabilities and helped us protect the integrity and availability of NASA information."

## 4. Key Projects & Open Source Repositories

### Kalengh (Techsynx/kalengh)
- Description: Discreet real-time AI assistant for live screen and audio contextual assistance.
- Tech Stack: Python, Whisper, Vision LLMs, Screen Capture API, WebSockets.
- Repository: https://github.com/Techsynx/kalengh

### AutoFlow — Multi-Agent Business Automation Platform
- Description: Self-hosted agentic platform orchestrating 12 business workflows including lead qualification, multi-format invoice parsing, social media scheduling, and bi-directional CRM synchronization.
- Tech Stack: n8n, LangGraph, LangChain, Pinecone Vector DB, OpenAI GPT-4o, FastAPI.
- Impact: Decreased client administrative manual tasks by 60% within 30 days of deployment.

### ChurnGuard — Production MLOps Churn Prediction Engine
- Description: End-to-end machine learning system predicting customer churn for financial institutions with 91% accuracy.
- Features: Containerized FastAPI REST API, live SHAP interpretability dashboard, automated data drift monitoring with Evidently AI, and automated retraining CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions.
- Tech Stack: XGBoost, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, Docker, SHAP, Evidently AI.

### DeFi Sentinel — On-Chain Analytics & Anomaly Detection
- Description: Blockchain analytics system monitoring smart contracts on Ethereum and Polygon.
- Features: Real-time event queries via Web3.py and The Graph subgraphs, unsupervised Isolation Forest anomaly detection for rug-pull identification (87% precision), and instant Telegram alerting.
- Tech Stack: Python, Web3.py, The Graph, Solidity, Isolation Forest, Telegram API.

### Fraud AI — Real-Time Synthetic Text Detection API
- Description: Deep-learning NLP classifier determining whether submitted text was generated by language models (89%+ accuracy).
- Features: Optimized inference with ONNX runtime achieving sub-200ms latency, handling 500+ requests daily.
- Tech Stack: Hugging Face Transformers, RoBERTa, FastAPI, ONNX Runtime.
